text: Boat registration: classification is required.
Boat registration: if classification is Other, classificationOther is required.
Boat registration: shipName is required, max length 13, and uses vessel name availability validation.
Boat registration: typeOfHull is required.
Boat registration: if typeOfHull is Other, typeOfHullOther is required.
Boat registration: hullNumber is required, max length 50, and must pass hull number availability validation.
Boat registration: hullColor is required and max length is 100.
Boat registration: berthingPlace is required.
Boat registration: if berthingPlace is Other, berthingPlaceOther is required.
Boat registration: dateOfBuild is required.
Boat registration: placeOfBuild is required and max length is 100.
Boat registration: previouslyRegistered is required.
Boat registration: when previouslyRegistered is Yes, previousNamesOfShip is required.
Boat registration: when previouslyRegistered is Yes, previousRegistrationNumber is required.
Boat registration: when previouslyRegistered is Yes, previousRegistrationDate is required.
Boat registration: when previouslyRegistered is Yes, previousPortOfRegistry is required.
Boat registration: grossTonnage is required and numeric.
Boat registration: lengthOA is required and numeric.
Boat registration: noOfCrews is required and numeric.
Boat registration: printingHouse is required.
Boat registration: acquisitionOfOwnership is required.
Boat registration: vesselMortgaged is required.
Boat registration: when vesselMortgaged is Yes, mortgageInformationBankName is required.
Boat registration: when vesselMortgaged is Yes and mortgageInformationBankName is Other, mortgageInformationBankNameOther is required.
Boat registration: when vesselMortgaged is Yes, mortgageNumber is required.
Boat registration: alternate ship names name1, name2, name3, and name4 are required with max length 13.
Boat registration: engine form requires enginesType and hp; if enginesType is Other, enginesTypeOther is required.
Boat registration required documents: copyOfCPR is required.
Boat registration required documents: builderCertificate is required when previouslyRegistered is No.
Boat registration required documents: deletionCertificate is required when previouslyRegistered is Yes.
Boat registration required documents: customsDeclaration is required when placeOfBuild is not Bahrain.
Boat registration required documents: mortgageDeed is required when vesselMortgaged is Yes.
Dhow registration follows the same core validations as Boat registration for ship, engine, and document rules.
Dhow registration required documents: copyOfCPR is required.
Dhow registration required documents: builderCertificate is required when previouslyRegistered is No.
Dhow registration required documents: deletionCertificate is required when previouslyRegistered is Yes.
Dhow registration required documents: customsDeclaration is required when placeOfBuild is not Bahrain.
Dhow registration required documents: mortgageDeed is required when vesselMortgaged is Yes.
Jet Ski registration: typeOfHull is required.
Jet Ski registration: if typeOfHull is Other, typeOfHullOther is required.
Jet Ski registration: hullNumber is required, max length 50, and must pass hull number availability validation.
Jet Ski registration: hullColor is required and max length is 100.
Jet Ski registration: berthingPlace is required; if Other, berthingPlaceOther is required.
Jet Ski registration: dateOfBuild and placeOfBuild are required.
Jet Ski registration: enginesType and hp are required; if enginesType is Other, enginesTypeOther is required.
Jet Ski registration: previouslyRegistered is required.
Jet Ski registration: when previouslyRegistered is Yes, previousRegistrationNumber, previousRegistrationDate, and previousPortOfRegistry are required.
Jet Ski registration: lengthOA is required and numeric.
Jet Ski registration: noOfPassengers is required and numeric.
Jet Ski registration: acquisitionOfOwnership is required.
Jet Ski registration: printingHouse is required.
Jet Ski required documents: copyOfCpr is required.
Jet Ski required documents: builderCertificate is required when previouslyRegistered is No.
Jet Ski required documents: deletionCertificate is required when previouslyRegistered is Yes.
Jet Ski required documents: customsDeclaration is required when placeOfBuild is not Bahrain.
Jet Ski imageUploadForm.imageProof is required.
